raw_request_summary: Add a requirement challenge and change snapshots to the Yalla run-control pipeline.

findings: The request is valuable because it catches unclear or risky work before implementation.
The smallest useful scope is generic protocol docs, config parsing, and install/test coverage.
required_changes: Keep project-specific policy out of upstream Yalla and let downstream repos configure local triggers.

findings: The change fits the existing knowledge-base and install.sh distribution model.
No migration or external service dependency is required.
The implementation can stay local to markdown protocols, config parsing, and contract tests.
The new artifacts should remain under .pipeline/ in consuming repos.
The install path must be tested because nested schema/example files are easy to omit.
required_changes: Add a contract test proving install.sh vendors the new nested files and rewrites plugin-root references.

judge.summary: Proceed after limiting upstream scope to generic run-control protocols and adding install coverage.
accepted_scope: Generic Requirement Court protocol, schema, and example.
Generic Change Snapshots protocol, schema, and example.
YALLA config parsing and docs wiring.
risk_notes: Downstream repos may overuse the court unless docs keep tiny fixes exempt.
Snapshots must avoid secrets, raw customer data, and large binary copies.

human_confirmation.notes: No money, access, user data, outbound communication, or destructive action is changed.
